name: Sea of Thieves Tracker
description: Sync your Sea of Thieves gold, Hourglass rank and reputation to your tracker. Your session never leaves this browser.
//optional_host_permissions: A deployed tracker lives on a domain nobody knows at build time. Rather than shipping a hardcoded URL (or asking testers to edit the manifest), the popup requests access to whatever address its owner types — granted per origin, by a click, at that moment.
